Name: HTT Japan - Fish Pond
Author: Otterhead
Description:
[center][size=6]星の[/size][size=6]露[/size][size=6]の谷[/size]
[size=5][u]H[/u]oshi no [u]T[/u]suyu no [u]T[/u]ani (HTT)[/size]
[size=3] ⁂ Valley of the Dew of the Star ⁂[/size]
[/center]


[size=3]This is another addition to the HTT universe: the ever-requested fish pond. A lot of people have asked to have something that aligns better with the Japanese aesthetic, so here it is! Originally I was going to enter this into the 2026 Modfest, but missed the deadline by a little... (thought it was until the last day of March). Oh well! Base garden, plus stone lantern, ancient pine tree, and yukimidoro decoration options. Shows visual difference in the collection pool when golden animal cracker is applied.[/size]
[size=3]
Many of my HTT mods are based off real places in Japan to encourage players to one day go see them in person. This fish pond design is inspired by the [url=https://www.kanpai-japan.com/tokyo/kyu-shiba-rikyu]Kyuu Shiba Rikyuu Garden[/url]﻿ in Tokyo, one of the oldest surviving feudal gardens in the region. The natural elements even made it through the Great Kanto earthquake, though all standing structures like tea houses, etc, were destroyed back then.
_____

I really love [/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9704]Updated Seasonal Japanese Buildings[/url] and have used it since I started playing Stardew Valley with mods. However, it's missing buildings from some mod expansions (like SVE), some of the buildings are not coherent as an aesthetic, and there are things I want to change in general, so I've used it as inspiration going forward. There are open permissions from the original creator [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3947][size=3]S[/size][size=3]onreirblah[/size][/url][size=3] because they are no longer working on the initial mod at all, and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Leroymilo/about-me?gameId=1303]Leroymilo[/url] was kind enough to give permission for me to use whatever they had also added on to the mod when they updated it for 1.6.[/size]
[size=3]
[i]I create my visual mods digitally by hand out of a desire to share my love of Japanese architecture and aesthetics, and do not condone the use of AI in creative works like images, visual design, graphic design, etc. AI is a tool that should be used sparingly, responsibly, and ethically.[/i]
_____
